name: IRWIN
source:
A child named Irwin wakes up in a strange room alongside another child named Olli. Together, they must find the courage to escape.

[From [url=https://murderduck.itch.io/irwin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫欧文的孩子在一个陌生的房间里醒来，旁边还有另一个名叫奥利的孩子。他们必须一起找到逃跑的勇气。

[来自[url=https://murderduck.itch.io/irwin]Itch.io[/url]]
